newsitem.title: INDIA: Heart transplanted into 11-year-old in India.
newsitem.headline: Heart transplanted into 11-year-old in India.

text.p: An 11-year-old boy has undergone a successful heart transplant, becoming India's youngest recipient of a donor heart, hospital officials said on Monday.
The Madras Medical Mission said the surgery late on Sunday was also significant because the donor's heart was removed from an accident victim at a distant hospital.
The heart was removed from the accident victim at Apollo Hospitals in Madras, placed in ice and taken 12 km (7.5 miles) to the Madras Medical Mission's Institute of Cardio Vascular Diseases.

"The donor heart thus was deprived of blood circulation for nearly three hours and 10 minutes," the mission said in a statement, adding that the patient was recovering with no post-operative problems.
It was the fifth heart transplant at the institute, and all previous recipients were leading normal lives, the statement said.
